description: This file defines the class 'Smarty_Internal_Runtime_TplFunction', which manages runtime operations for template functions within the Smarty templating engine. It includes methods for calling, registering, retrieving, and caching template functions, as well as saving and restoring template variables during runtime.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Runtime_TplFunction
classes.description: Handles runtime management of template functions, including calling, registering, caching, and managing template variables during template rendering.

methods.name: callTemplateFunction
methods.description: Invokes a specified template function, handling cache and dynamic loading as necessary.

methods.name: registerTplFunctions
methods.description: Registers multiple template functions to a template object, optionally overriding existing functions.

methods.name: getTplFunction
methods.description: Retrieves the source information array for a specific template function or all functions if no name is provided.

methods.name: addTplFuncToCache
methods.description: Adds a template function to the cache file for nocache calls, dynamically loading the function if possible.

methods.name: saveTemplateVariables
methods.description: Saves current template variables onto a stack for later restoration.

methods.name: restoreTemplateVariables
methods.description: Restores template variables from a previously saved stack frame.
